quotes.quote: Score is the dot product of weights and features; the preferred margin is the dot product with that difference.

For one preferred pair, loss is the logarithm of one plus the exponential of the negative margin. Its gradient is negative feature difference times sigmoid of negative margin. At zero weights that sigmoid is one half, giving gradient point zero five, negative point three. Subtract point three times the gradient: weights become negative point zero one five, positive point zero nine, and the preferred margin becomes point zero five five five.

quotes.quote: Serving time chooses the request’s chronological window. Feature availability must be no later than serving, and a judgment cannot be available before its request.

quotes.quote: At a fixed context, assume relevance is independent of examination, and examination depends only on position. Then click probability is examination propensity p times relevance probability r.

quotes.quote: Our pairwise score orders products; it is not a purchase probability. A separate calibrated model may estimate probability of click and probability of purchase given that click.
